d: In this video, we explore the troubling reality of India's judicial system through the story of Sopan Narsinga Gaikwad, who was ensnared in a court battle over a piece of land for nearly 50 years. Despite a favorable ruling initially, his case got bounced between courts, revealing a significant backlog affecting 5.3 crore pending cases nationwide. This delay is exacerbated by a shortage of judges; India has only about 21,000 judges for 1.4 billion people, leading to prolonged legal proceedings. Moreover, many candidates fail to pass judicial exams, compounding the staffing crisis. We…
